messages:
Priya: Heads-up - eval harness flagged a quality delta for the new int8 build on multilingual promptset. Spanish + Japanese examples show translation drift and hallucinated extra steps.
Kofi: saw the dashboard. avg BLEU down ~6% on es ja, but en/pt fine. is this tokenizer/quant mismatch?
Linh: early hypothesis: quantized weights + subword boundary rounding -> different tokenization alignment for long instructions (we see token insertions).
Arjun: annoying. our label pool mixes languages - that could hide real regressions. recommend immediate micro-golden refresh per language and separate queues.
Priya: agree. plan: 1) reserve micro-gold: 30 samples per affected lang (es, ja) 2) create language-tagged label queues 3) interleave FP16 controls 4) rerun small eval comparing fp16 vs int8 on those families
Kofi: ok. I'll schedule the eval. suggest 200 examples (100 es,100 ja) focused on long-instruction and multi-turn translation prompts. include existing gold where we can.
Linh: I'll run tokenizer diffs across the failing examples and dump token alignments. quick snippet:
```
for ex in samples:
  a = tokenizer.fp16(ex.input)
  b = tokenizer.int8(ex.input)
  if a != b: log(diff(a,b))
```
Arjun: labeler-side: add UI badge "LANG: ES / CANARY" and a short note "Expect tokenization variance on int8 - flag only clear semantic regressions"
label-bot: automated: created queues "label-es-int8-3660004321" and "label-ja-int8-3660004321". reserved 60 golden slots named "gold-micro-int8-3660004321"
Priya: awesome. also set sampling weight: es/ja micro-gold => priority high, throttle overall canary labels to 4%
Kofi: eval-bot, please include hidden fp16 control at 10% rate so we can compute true effect size.
eval-bot: scheduled: "int8_vs_fp16_multilang_3660004321" with hidden control=10% and metrics=[BLEU, chrF, halluc_rate].
Linh: I'll also check KV-cache interaction for multi-turn translation - maybe cache scoring skew on int8 causes incoherent continuations.
Arjun: ops: tagging oncall to monitor model pool memory + any OOMs. if token-err-rate > 1% trigger fallback to fp16 for that language pool.
oncall-ml: added monitors: model.int8.es.token-err-rate, model.int8.ja.hallucination-score. alert policy created.
Priya: next steps: Linh deliver token diff + candidate failing ids in 45m; Kofi kick off eval job now; Arjun coordinate UI + queue changes; I'll draft short labeler guidance and ping localization team for adjudication help. reconvene in 1.5h. :pray:
